ct_bible_rock.blurb: Bible Rock is a small bouldering spot in the Seven Falls park near Middle Haddam, with 11 problems that run from the easiest grades up to about V4. The namesake boulder is a big semi-buried block split like a half-open book, and most of the lines are on its far side. Expect friction-and-smear climbing on small edges that can crumble, so test holds with care. Plenty of the top-outs end in awkward downclimbs, which makes a spotter or a pad worth having. More boulders sit across the road, a short walk off. Ticks are common in the area, so bug protection is a good idea.

ct_a_midsummer_nightsession.blurb: A Midsummer Nightsession is a small cluster of boulders and cliffline on the hillside in God's Country on West Rock, tucked between the Patience boulder and the Tibbs area. Most of the 11 lines are boulder problems from V0 to about V5, with a couple of roped trad lines up the cliff, one around 5.10 and a harder one near 5.12. It sits higher on the slope than Patience, past a little talus field, and the surrounding God's Country area feels secluded and stays fairly cool in summer. The stone in the neighborhood is gritty and rounded with good friction.

ct_campsite_crag.blurb: Campsite Crag is a small cliff deep in Nepaug State Forest in the Western Highlands, and it is the forest's one main climbing wall. The 11 routes are mostly bolted lines in the 5.10 to 5.12 range, with a couple of easier trad lines and one harder trad route. The faces are vertical rather than tall, with enjoyable movement. It is a newer development with little history behind it, and the forest around it is better known for mountain biking, so you may have the place to yourself. A river nearby is handy for a swim after a day of climbing.

ct_groton_bluff_point.blurb: Groton Bluff Point is a coastal bouldering spot in Groton with just two boulders. One sits right at the point and is a block of nice-quality stone. The other is a tidal slab to the east that has room for many more problems at every grade. The slab is tide dependent, in good shape around mid tide and through low tide. Problems are all boulders, from very easy up to a hard V10 at the top end, with a handful in the V2 to V4 range. The setting is scenic, right on the shore.
